findings.evidence_quote: ISO 4914 UPI, 12-character alphanumeric code including a check digit.
findings.reasoning: UKEMIR already contains the field 'Unique product identifier (UPI)' (Table 2, Item 8). The field is defined under ISO 4914 as a 12-character alphanumeric code including a check digit. It applies to derivatives across asset classes, including commodity derivatives, satisfying the requirement without conflict.
